title: Platform runtime-query synchronizer assumes every canonical module uses repository templates
actual: After F185 module inventory validation passes, sync fails because cpf-tools/db/runtime-template/cmn/repository does not exist.
rootCause: The synchronizer has one processing mode: repository/<key>.sql.template rendered into each vendor pack. Canonical Common instead declares exact resource paths under calendar/ and template/, uses positional parameterCount, and publishes a single portable cpf-common resource tree validated by verify-cpf-cmn-runtime-query-contract.py. The former three-module hard-code hid this missing dispatch path.
partialOutput: The failed F186-discovery sync had already rendered the six new F184 Backoffice queries for each of three vendors before reaching Common, adding 18 valid but not yet fully gated projections. They remain in the Primary Workspace and are included in the next Source identity; no hand copy or external merge occurred.
repair: The synchronizer dispatches modules only when every statement either uses repository-key mode or safe portable resource mode; mixed mode fails. Resource mode enforces unique safe relative .sql paths, exact author/contract/target inventory, parameter count, no vendor token, byte-exact copy once, stale SQL removal with empty-directory cleanup inside the validated Workspace target, and check mode. Optional managedMyBatis access is StrictMode-safe.
verification: PASS: resource-mode regression 1/1; complete SYNC and CHECK each process 14 portable resources exactly once; independent verify-cpf-cmn-runtime-query-contract.py reports 14/14 statements, 14 author resources, 14 runtime resources and zero findings; Source identity remains f5f64570aba2abc5a14ebd60b06d51681e2f7873e1101534d275d8b72f9da779.
repairPlan: Reopen only on portable resource path/parameter/byte/inventory drift.
falseGreenForbidden: Do not fabricate cmn/repository, write the same common target three times, skip CMN parameter/resource parity, or remove Common from requiredModules.
